cases.procedure: POST /auth/v1/signup with a valid new (Mapua) email
cases.remarks: Email confirmation disabled, so signup logs in immediately.

cases.procedure: POST token grant with correct credentials
cases.expected: Authenticated; token issued; redirect to dashboard

cases.procedure: POST token grant with wrong password
cases.remarks: App maps this to 'Incorrect email or password' (auth_service._mapAuthException).

cases.procedure: Load profile + recent scans the dashboard renders
cases.remarks: Data load verified via API; on-screen nav/rendering to be captured from the app (HomeShell has 4 tabs).

cases.procedure: Capture a face image via device camera
cases.expected: Image accepted and prepared for analysis
cases.remarks: Requires a physical device; capture path exists in camera_screen.dart. Verify manually on the APK.

cases.procedure: Upload a JPEG to scan-images storage (gallery pick)
cases.expected: Image accepted and stored, ready for analysis
cases.remarks: API upload verified; UI gallery picker (image_picker) works on web/mobile - capture screenshot from app.

cases.procedure: Submit analysis with no image fields
cases.expected: Submission prevented / handled error, no crash
cases.remarks: Edge function returns handled 400 'Missing scan_id or image_path'; app also blocks submit with no image.

cases.procedure: Submit a valid image to analyze-scan (Roboflow/HF)
cases.expected: Image sent to external API; response received
cases.remarks: External API dependency + ~5-10s latency (cold start possible).

cases.procedure: Inspect analysis result payload the result screen renders
cases.remarks: Result fields present in payload; scan_detail_screen renders them. Screenshot from app.

cases.procedure: Check result wording for a monitoring-only disclaimer
cases.expected: Presented as monitoring support; no diagnosis/treatment claim
cases.actual: No explicit non-diagnostic disclaimer found in UI; results shown as neutral severity grades only
cases.remarks: System makes NO diagnostic/treatment claim (good), but the REQUIRED 'monitoring only, not a diagnosis' notice is absent. Recommend adding a disclaimer banner on the result screen.

cases.procedure: Verify the analyzed scan persisted with metadata
cases.expected: Scan row with image ref, date, result, metadata saved

cases.procedure: Patch a note onto the scan and read it back
cases.expected: Note saved and linked to the scan

cases.procedure: Open one record; verify image ref, date, result, notes
Retrieve multiple dated grades for trend
cases.remarks: Trend data present; SeverityTrendChart renders it on the dashboard - screenshot from app.

cases.procedure: Retrieve scans + history + plan bundle the report compiles
cases.expected: Organized scans, dates, notes, summaries for consult
cases.actual: scans HTTP 200, history HTTP 200, plan HTTP 200
cases.remarks: Report data retrievable; PDF is generated client-side (DoctorReportService) - export/screenshot from app.
Server logout confirmed; app clears session and routes to WelcomeScreen (auth_service.signOut).

cases.expected: User B cannot access User A's records
